description: Built-in furniture catalog of the engine. Built-in items are parametric (generators in src/home/catalog/generators.ts): light, dimensionally correct, no external files. The runtimeModel field lets you add GLB / glTF models (type: glb, url) without changing the app.

conventions.dimensions: w — width (local x axis), d — depth (local y axis; back of the item at y = −d/2, front at +d/2), h — height; metres
conventions.origin: centre of the footprint in plan, bottom of the item on the floor
conventions.parametric: [min, max, step] ranges in metres for dimensions the user may change
conventions.variants: size / type variants (e.g. bed 90–180); variant dimensions override dimensions
conventions.materialSlots: materials of the item parts (ids from data/materialCatalog.json); mainSlot — the part whose material the user changes
conventions.placement: wall — back against a wall (snaps to walls), free — free-standing, under — slides under a top (chair)
